notes: Generated by internal/core/entities/catalogbuild (docs/10 section 7). Left out: 237 pages of content outside the game (events, leagues, Deadman, betas, historical), 392 pages without NPC ids, 29 unnamed pages. A name several pages carry resolves to the page titled with it, else it is ambiguous.
